title: Why Leaves Change Color
text:
Every autumn, the leaves on many trees change color. First, the trees stop making a green substance called chlorophyll. When the green color goes away, yellow and orange colors can be seen.

Scientists say this happens because trees prepare for winter. Cold weather and shorter days tell the tree to stop making food from sunlight. After the leaves fall, the tree can rest until spring.

questions.text: What colors can be seen when the green color goes away?
What do the trees prepare for, according to scientists?
Why does a tree probably stop making food in autumn?
options: Its leaves have become too heavy.
The days get shorter and the weather gets colder.
It wants to change its color.

questions.text: What can the reader most likely conclude about the tree during winter?
options: It needs its leaves to survive the winter.
It no longer needs its leaves during the winter.
It will grow new leaves in the winter.
Its leaves protect it from the cold.

vocabulary.definition: the season between summer and winter
a green substance in plants that helps them use sunlight to make food
light that comes from the sun

paragraph_translations: Кожної осені листя на багатьох деревах змінює колір. Спочатку дерева припиняють виробляти зелену речовину, яка називається хлорофілом. Коли зелений колір зникає, можна побачити жовті та помаранчеві кольори.

Науковці кажуть, що це відбувається тому, що дерева готуються до зими. Холодна погода та коротші дні змушують дерево припинити виробляти їжу із сонячного світла. Після того як листя опадає, дерево може відпочивати до весни.
